--docker-clean.help: Kill containers, remove and prune all docker images, volumes, and system, be carefull when using this option

--drop-set-cookie.help: Ignore Set-Cookie header from HTTP responses

--endpoint.help: Url serving as endpoint for both attacker and target

--exclude.help: Adds a url to exclude from the scan

--external-endpoint.help: Url serving as endpoint for target

--flush-attacks.help: Flush attack history and vulnerabilities for the current session

--flush-session.help: Flush everything that was previously found for this target (crawled URLs, vulns, etc)

--form-enctype.help: Set enctype to use to POST form data to form URL

--form-script.help: Use a custom Python authentication plugin

--format.help: Set output format. Supported: csv, html, json, md, txt, xml. Default is html.

--header.help: Set a custom header to use for every requests

--headless.help: Use a Firefox headless crawler for browsing (slower). Use 'both' to run standard then headless.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--internal-endpoint.help: Url serving as endpoint for attacker

--jwt.help: Set a JWT token use for every request for authenticated scan.

--list-modules.help: List Wapiti attack modules and exit

--max-attack-time.help: Set how many seconds you want each attack module to last (floats accepted)

--max-files-per-dir.help: Set how many pages the scanner should explore per directory

--max-links-per-page.help: Set how many (in-scope) links the scanner should extract for each page

--max-parameters.help: URLs and forms having more than MAX input parameters will be erased before attack.

--max-scan-time.help: Set how many seconds you want the scan to last (floats accepted)

--mitm-port.help: Instead of crawling, launch an intercepting proxy on the given port

--no-bugreport.help: Don't send automatic bug report when an attack module fails

--proxy.help: Set the HTTP(S) proxy to use. Supported: http(s) and socks proxies

--resume-crawl.help: Resume the scanning process (if stopped) even if some attacks were previously performed

--scan-force.help: Easy way to reduce the number of scanned and attacked URLs. Possible values: paranoid, sneaky, polite, normal, aggressive, insane

--side-file.help: Use a .side file generated using Selenium IDE to perform an authenticated scan.

--skip-crawl.help: Don't resume the scanning process, attack URLs scanned during a previous session

--start.help: Adds a url to start scan with

--store-config.help: Directory where to store configuration databases.

--store-session.help: Directory where to store attack history and session data.

--swagger.help: Swagger file URI (path or URL) to target API endpoints

--tasks.help: Number of concurrent tasks to use for the exploration (crawling) of the target.

--update.help: Update Wapiti attack modules and exit

--url.help: The base URL used to define the scan scope (default scope is folder)

--user-agent.help: Set a custom user-agent to use for every requests

--verbose.help: Set verbosity level (0: quiet, 1: normal, 2: verbose)

--verbose-build.help: Print the build messages before running the tests

--verify-ssl.help: Set SSL check (default is no check)

--version.help: Show program's version number and exit

--wait.help: Wait the specified amount of seconds before analyzing a webpage (headless mode only)

--wapp-dir.help: Provide a custom directory path for updating Wappalyzer Database

--wapp-url.help: Provide a custom URL for updating Wappalyzer Database
